newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower, commercials on both sides.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower, commercials on both sides.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed unchanged to lower in thin dealings with commercials on both sides of the market, traders said.
"A commercial sold the early rally but there was commercial buying at the lows (day's lows)," a trader said.
Traders said position squaring was noted before the release Thursday of USDA's world and U.S. supply/demand reports and weekly export sales report.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 450 contracts, above the 393 traded Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
Rice futures closed unchanged to 2-1/2 cents per cwt lower, with January down 2-1/2 at $10.61.
